Hero.sub: From the API that runs a tournament bracket to the client that reads player input - we test the layer where cheating, fraud and platform compromise actually happen. Not generic infra scanning: security testing that understands game logic.
Hero.note: Built by people who shipped real-time infrastructure for competitive gaming. Authorized testing only - every engagement starts with a signed scope.

Mission.statementSuffix: - and learned exactly where that kind of system breaks.
Mission.follow: Today we apply that to offensive security: pentest, exploit simulation and game-logic auditing for platforms, tournaments and studios. What we list here is what we actually do - not a services menu copied from a generic MSSP.

Capabilities.heading: Not generic infra security.
Capabilities.intro: Every item below is a real technique we use - not a checklist copied from an MSSP playbook.

items.title: Surface mapping
items.body: API endpoints, matchmaking flow, client-server boundary - we map what an attacker, or a cheater, would actually target first.

items.title: Business-logic abuse
items.body: Item duplication, currency exploits, auth bypass, rank manipulation - the vulnerabilities scanners don't find because they're not broken code, they're broken assumptions.

items.title: Cheat simulation
items.body: We build the same class of tooling a real cheater would, in a controlled environment, to measure what your detection actually catches.

items.title: Load & resilience testing
items.body: Simulated load against matchmaking, tournament brackets and live-event infrastructure - measured before a real audience finds the breaking point during a final.

items.title: Retest, not a PDF and gone
items.body: Every finding is retested after the fix ships. Severity, evidence and status - tracked until it's actually closed, not just reported once.

items.title: Written authorization, always
items.body: No test starts without a signed scope and written authorization from whoever owns the system. No exceptions.

Privacy.intro: This policy covers effront.gg only -- the institutional site you're reading right now. If we run a client engagement, the scope and data handling for that project are covered separately, in writing, as part of the engagement contract. This page only covers what happens when you interact with effront.gg itself.

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: This site has no accounts, no sign-up forms, and no cookie-based tracking. The only information we receive is whatever you choose to send us: if you email contato@effront.gg (a job application, a scope inquiry, a general question), we receive your email address, name, and whatever else you include in that message. Standard web server logs (IP address, browser type, pages requested) may be collected by our hosting provider for security and uptime purposes.

sections.title: 2. How we use it
sections.body: To respond to your message; to evaluate a job application, if that's what you sent; to keep our infrastructure secure and available. We don't use anything you send us for marketing, and we don't build a profile from it.

sections.title: 3. Data sharing and disclosure
sections.body: We do not sell, rent, or share your information with advertisers. A job application may be shared internally with whoever is involved in hiring for that role. We may disclose information if required by law.

sections.title: 4. Data retention
sections.body: We keep email correspondence and job applications for as long as reasonably needed to respond or complete a hiring process, then delete it. You can ask us to delete anything you've sent us at any time.

sections.title: 5. Security
sections.body: Email sent to contato@effront.gg travels through our email provider's standard security. This site doesn't handle passwords, payment data, or player accounts -- any system we test under a client engagement is covered by that engagement's own data-handling terms, not this policy.

sections.title: 6. Your rights (LGPD)
sections.body: You can ask us, at any time, to: tell you what we have on file about you; correct it; delete it; send you a copy. Contact contato@effront.gg for any of this.

sections.title: 7. Children's privacy
sections.body: This site is not directed at children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect information from them.

sections.title: 8. International data transfers
sections.body: Email and hosting infrastructure may be located outside Brazil. We take reasonable steps to keep your information protected wherever it's processed.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.body: If this policy changes in a meaningful way, we'll update the date at the top of this page.

Privacy.note: This text was written in-house based on what effront.gg actually does today. We recommend a formal legal review before treating it as a definitive document.
